title: Server control
description: Schedule a graceful restart or shutdown, toggle maintenance mode, and edit the login message of the day.

shutdown.title: Graceful restart / shutdown
shutdown.offlineNote: The game server is offline. Start it before scheduling a restart or shutdown.

confirm.title: Confirm server {{mode}}
confirm.body: The server will broadcast warnings and {{mode}} in {{minutes}} minute(s), saving and disconnecting {{online}} online player(s).

maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
maintenance.description: When enabled, only GM accounts (Moderator and above) can log in. Players trying to log in get the client's own "Server maintenance. Please try again later!". The message below goes to the players disconnected when it's switched on.
maintenance.messagePlaceholder: The server is currently under maintenance. Please try again later.
maintenance.savedLive: Maintenance settings updated on the live server.
maintenance.savedOffline: Maintenance settings saved; they will apply when the game server starts.

motd.title: Message of the day (MOTD)
motd.description: Sent as notice lines to every character right after login. Leave empty to disable.
motd.label: Login message
motd.placeholder:
Welcome to Fetih Online!
Type /help for commands.
motd.savedLive: MOTD updated on the live server.
motd.savedOffline: MOTD saved; it will apply when the game server starts.
